Actions.Name: Usage Gauge
Actions.Tooltip: Shows Claude session/weekly/monthly usage and time until reset

Actions.Name: Peak Clock
Actions.Tooltip: Shows a 24h clock with Claude's peak hours marked, whether it's currently peak or off-peak, and time until the next transition

Actions.Name: Metric Tile
Actions.Tooltip: Shows total Claude tokens or cost for today/7 days/the current session, estimated from local Claude Code logs or billed from the Console Admin API

Actions.Name: Burn Rate
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how fast a Claude usage window is burning: pace per hour/day, even-burn ratio, or runway until empty

Actions.Name: Session + Weekly
Actions.Tooltip: Shows Claude's 5-hour session and 7-day weekly usage together, as two bars

Actions.Name: Usage Heatmap
Actions.Tooltip: Shows daily Claude Code tokens or estimated cost over the last 7 days or 4 weeks as heat cells

Actions.Name: Usage Sparkline
Actions.Tooltip: Shows a trend line of your Claude session, weekly or monthly extra usage: usage trend, increase per poll, today's increase, or pace vs even burn

Actions.Name: API Spend
Actions.Tooltip: Shows billed Claude Console (API) spend for your organization today, over 7 days or this month, from the Usage & Cost Admin API
